content.text:
I made three small refactor commits. The crate was already in good shape, so I stopped there rather than churn it. All tests pass and `cargo clippy --all-targets` reports nothing. Behavior is unchanged.

- **`b06c255` Name the visibility-timeout and delay limits.** The literals `43_200` and `900` were repeated in attribute parsing and the message commands. They are now `MAX_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT` and `MAX_DELAY_SECONDS` in `attributes.rs`.
- **`ec89f71` Share the MissingParameter error.** `message_commands.rs` had its own copy of the error that `Params::require` builds. Both now use `request::missing`.
- **`660f970` Validate ContentBasedDeduplication in one place.** `CreateQueue` and `SetQueueAttributes` had identical copies of the FIFO-only check. It is now `AttributeUpdate::check_deduplication_fits`.

I left `send_message` and `receive_message` alone. They are the longest functions, and splitting them would take more than a small, safe change. If you want that next, I'd start with `send_message`.
